data.title: 伊莉雅丝菲尔 · 圣杯战争
data.description: 【伊莉雅 · 圣杯战争】烈火燃烧的废墟战场上，娇小的伊莉雅傲然端坐在庞大如巨山的狂战士（Berserker）肩头，狂风肆虐吹乱她的银白长发。她俯视着战场发出银铃般清脆的笑声——「Berserker，把阻挡在大哥哥面前的敌对从者全部碾碎！这就是爱因兹贝伦的力量！」
data.location: 冬木市燃烧的街道废墟
data.camera: wide low-angle two-character shot, full Berserker figure and Illya seated on his shoulder
data.promptProse: Illyasviel sits securely on Berserker’s broad muscular shoulder above a ruined street in Fuyuki. Her purple fur-trimmed winter coat and long white hair lift in the wind as she extends one commanding hand toward the distant battlefield, ruby eyes bright with confidence. Berserker stands planted among broken paving stones beneath her, his battle skirt and greaves visible and his weapon held low. Firelight edges the two distinct figures while cool moonlight separates Illya’s silhouette from the smoke. One girl riding on one towering warrior’s shoulder, both fully within the vertical frame, no injuries or lettering.
